notes.title: MAC Version is available
notes.notes: The MACOSX version of Power and Revolution 2019 Edition has just been released.

notes.title: Patch update 6.46
notes.notes:
Main corrections and improvements:

-Correction of reactions to electricity shortages for specific countries starting with a shortage (eg Russia)
-Correction of a savegame of a mod created with the modding tool of a version 2019 patch 6.44
-Possibility to modify the alignments with the God'n'spy between an illegal opponent played and a foreign character (diplomat, party leader, terrorist)

We would like to thank the entire community and beta testers for their collaboration in improving the game. 

If you encounter any bugs or inaccuracies in the game, or if you have suggestions for improvements, do not hesitate to contact us: on support@power-and-revolution.com (technical problems) or on contact@power-and-revolution.com (other problems or suggestions)

notes.title: 6.42 update
notes.notes: In this update, the executable will now automatically select the best graphic adapter (for ex Nvidia or Amd) in priority when the computer has several ones: this is the case on many laptops that have an Intel HD adaptater on the mother board in addition to the big 3d card. In this case, if the Intel card was selected, this made the game slower, but also could lead to random crashes if drivers were not uptodate.
